title: A gym alert that arrived with the admin app closed stays on the phone or computer after someone has dealt with it
what: With the admin app closed, a gym alert (a web page question, a join request, a shop order) shows as a notice on the staff's phones and computers. When one person handles it, the notice on every other device stays in the notice list as if it still needs someone. Nothing ever closes it: the background helper only shows notices and opens the app on a tap.
expected: When an alert is done, its notice disappears from every device that showed it, or at least from the device that opens the app next.
how_often: every alert handled while another device showed it
fix_line: When the app opens or an alert is marked done, close the notices for that alert

title: A web page visitor is told the gym will call them, but the gym may never hear of the question
what: After 'Ask the gym' or leaving a number in the AI helper, the visitor reads that the gym will call or WhatsApp them. The gym hears of it only through its alerts: a notice reaches staff only on a browser where someone turned alerts on, and when no device has alerts on the server marks the alert as sent to nobody. The question then waits in Enquiries until someone happens to open the admin app. The web page editor only says questions come to Enquiries; it never checks or says that no phone or computer will be told.
expected: Before the page takes questions, the editor says whether any phone or computer will be alerted and offers to turn alerts on; if nobody is set up, the visitor is not promised a call.
who: gym owners and people who may join
how_often: every question at a gym where no device has alerts on
fix_line: Show on the web page editor whether any device gets alerts, with a button to turn them on

items.reason: These web page alerts go to gym staff browsers, not members; field-fill.csv, the only allowed count source, has no staff-device, alerts-on or web-page row, so Crispy Curves staff reach cannot be counted. Members get none of these alerts.
